description: This PHP source file defines the 'CommonsSubController' class within the Goteo project's admin controller namespace. It handles administrative actions related to collective returns (retornos colectivos) for projects, such as editing, viewing, approving fulfillment, adding, editing, deleting rewards, and listing projects with social rewards. The class extends an abstract subcontroller and integrates with various models like Project, Reward, User, etc., implementing access control, project management, and reward handling functionalities.

classes.name: CommonsSubController
classes.description: Controller handling administrative actions for collective rewards within the Goteo project, including project management, reward editing, fulfillment, and listing projects with social rewards.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform certain actions based on user role and node configuration, with hardcoded exception for user 'contratos'.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Invokes the process method for editing a reward or project given an id and subaction.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Invokes the process method for adding a new reward or project.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Invokes the process method to delete a reward or project.

methods.name: infoAction
methods.description: Displays detailed contact information for a project.

methods.name: fulfillAction
methods.description: Marks a project as fulfilling the collective returns if applicable, logs the change, and redirects.

methods.name: viewAction
methods.description: Displays the social rewards of a project.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of projects with social rewards, with filters applied.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles core logic for various actions including project status changes, reward management, and listing projects. Contains multiple cases for different actions such as 'info', 'fulfill', 'view', 'add', 'edit', 'delete', and list filtering.
